final: WITH media_type_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS FLOAT) / Milliseconds) as byte_rate FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MediaTypeId), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) as overall_avg_rate FROM media_type_stats), filtered AS (SELECT mts.avg_unit_price, mts.byte_rate, mts.byte_rate - oa.overall_avg_rate as excess FROM media_type_stats mts CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE mts.byte_rate > oa.overall_avg_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_unit_price) as avg_of_avg_unit_prices, AVG(byte_rate) as avg_of_byte_rates, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM filtered
